## Core stack

- Backend: Java 21, Spring Boot, Spring Security, JPA/Hibernate, REST APIs, OpenAPI, Laravel, Flask.
- Frontend: Angular, React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Flutter.
- Data: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, Flyway, Firebase Firestore.
- Tools and quality: Docker, Git, GitHub Actions, Google Cloud Run, JUnit 5, Mockito, Testcontainers, Playwright, Vitest, ArchUnit, axe-core, Selenium.

## Selected projects

- **OdemLab** (2026, Zorium, team of four): skincare commerce platform with AI diagnosis and a React Native storefront. My work covered backend business modules, the web storefront/back-office and the order flow. Orders use server-side pricing, a state machine and idempotency; frontend types are generated from OpenAPI with CI drift checks; Flyway migrations replay from an empty database with duplicate-version protection, and admin notifications stay in sync across tabs. Private repository.
- **ProcureFlow** (2026): multi-tenant B2B procurement SaaS with requests, multi-level approvals, budgets, orders, invoices, audit trail and an AI copilot. Spring Boot, Angular, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Flyway, Playwright, Docker, Groq. [Repository](https://github.com/AhmedOL0/ProcureFlow).
- **Smart Campus Companion** (2026, team of four): Flutter campus app with QR room sheets, an AR view, timetable, bookings, moderated announcements and incident reports across three roles. Firebase/Firestore, Riverpod, ARCore/ARKit.
- **FitTrack** (2025): personal fitness web app with programmes, sessions and performance logs, a BMI/daily-energy health profile, an exercise library and an admin area. Java, Spring Boot, Next.js, React, MySQL, Docker.
- **MediCare** (2025, internship): Laravel clinic management with specialty search, online booking, schedules and patient records across patient, doctor and admin roles.
- **SmartSummarizer** (2025, team of four): NLP study tool that turns course PDFs into summaries, audio, quizzes and mind maps with CamemBERT and Groq.
- **Cane counting system** (2024, DUT final project): ESP8266 and laser sensor counting on a production line, with OLED display and a PHP/MySQL Wi-Fi dashboard.
